fact: Article 32 of the ordonnance regulating social networks and digital platforms, as published in the journal officiel, prohibits deepfakes of identifiable persons in sexual situations without consent, deepfakes attributing false statements to public figures, sexual depictions of minors and imitation of a state institution's identity for disinformation, with immediate referral to the emergency judge.
title: Gabon/Communication : encadrement strict de certains contenus générés par intelligence artificielle
